protocols.full/g1/d90: Full evaluation: 1 game per rule team and side = 32 matches of 90 s against all 16 rule-based teams (fixed seeds 50001..), plus best-move (greedy) play on every 2nd team, behaviour stats and head to head vs RL Team 4 / RL Team 5 / the start net. About 30-60 min on the Pi.
protocols.fast/g2/d60: Fast check: 2 games per team and side against every 3rd rule team (6 teams) = 24 matches of 60 s, plus head to head vs the start net. About 3-5 min. Only comparable with other fast checks.

rules: Never compare numbers of different protocols (fast vs full, or different match lengths).
Matches use fixed seeds, so two evaluations of one protocol play the same opponents, sides and kickoffs: compare them PAIRED (tracker.compare does when both records have 'matches').
A difference is real only if |z| > 1.96; with several arms against one reference use the Holm-corrected 'ablation' verdicts.
Sampled play (the default) twitches and concedes more than best-move (greedy) play; report both when judging a final team.

pts.unit: league points per match (win 3, draw 1, loss 0)
pts.definition: mean over the protocol's league matches

gd.definition: goals for minus goals against, mean per match

gd_se.definition: standard error of gd (null in old records)

greedy_pts.definition: same league, the net playing its best move instead of sampling (every 2nd team)

h2h.<opponent>.pts.definition: head to head vs another net, both sides; opponents: RL Team 4, RL Team 5, start (the net the run started from)

behaviour.dir_changes_s.unit: direction changes per second per player

behaviour.keeper_dist_px.unit: px from own goal of player slot 0 (not necessarily the de-facto keeper)

train_pts_vs_rules.definition: during training, last 200 matches vs the rule bots, sampled moves, 60% random starting layouts: a trend signal, not an evaluation

compare.pts / compare.gd.definition: difference a - b; paired over identical matches when possible

compare.mde.definition: smallest difference detectable at 5% two-sided with 80% power (2.8 x se of the difference)

cost_hours.definition: train = wall time training, eval = wall time of all evaluations of the run

states.done: trained the full budget and evaluated
states.diverged: stopped: training points fell under 70% of the start
states.regressed: stopped: two fast checks in a row worse than the start by > 2 se
states.imported: older run imported from logs (no spec)
